answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 10661 Country: India Title: As Salamualaikum Wo Rahmatullahi Wo Barakatuhu, After having an Intercourse Apart from taking ghusl, Is it mandatory to change the clothes, bed sheet and Blanket? Question: As Salamualaikum Wo Rahmatullahi Wo Barakatuhu, After having an Intercourse Apart from taking ghusl, Is it mandatory to change the clothes, bed sheet and Blanket? Answer ID: 10661 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 230/165=H/1429) It is not necessary to change, but the parts of bed, sheet and blanket etc smeared with semen will turn clean and pure after washing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
